message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **federal statutory holidays** that create long weekends in Canada for the calendar year 2023.  
(If you’re planning trips in a specific province, keep in mind that several provinces have their own holidays—most notably *Family Day* in Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, and Ontario—that will add extra long weekends.)

| Holiday | Calendar Date (2023) | Observed (if moved) | Long‑Weekend Window | Notes |
|---------|----------------------|---------------------|---------------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Sunday Jan 1 | Monday Jan 2 | **Jan 1–3** (Sun–Tue) | The holiday itself is on Jan 1; the observed day is Jan 2. |
| **Good Friday** | Friday Apr 7 | – | **Apr 7–9** (Fri–Sun) | Good Friday is a statutory holiday. |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday May 22 | – | **May 20–22** (Sat–Mon) | Celebrates Queen Victoria’s birthday. |
| **Canada Day** | Saturday Jul 1 | Monday Jul 3 | **Jul 1–3** (Sat–Mon) | The holiday falls on a weekend, so it’s observed on the following Monday. |
| **Labour Day** | Monday Sep 4 | – | **Sep 2–4** (Sat–Mon) | First Monday in September. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday Oct 9 | – | **Oct 7–9** (Sat–Mon) | First Monday in October. |
| **Remembrance Day** | Friday Nov 11 | Monday Nov 13 | **Nov 11–13** (Fri–Mon) | Observed on the following Monday if it falls on a weekend or a weekday that conflicts with other holidays. |
| **Christmas Day** | Monday Dec 25 | – | **Dec 23–25** (Sat–Mon) | The holiday itself is on Dec 25. |
| **Boxing Day** | Tuesday Dec 26 | – | **Dec 24–26** (Sun–Tue) | The holiday itself is on Dec 26. |

### How to Use This List

1. **Plan Your Trips** – If you’re looking for a “long weekend” getaway, any of the windows above gives you at least three consecutive days off (including the weekend).
2. **Check Provincial Variations** – For example, *Family Day* (Feb 20 in most provinces) creates a long weekend Feb 18–20. If you’re in a province that observes it, add that to your calendar.
3. **Verify with Official Sources** – The Government of Canada’s holiday calendar (or your provincial government’s website) will confirm the exact observed dates for your region.

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app or spreadsheet. If you need the same information for another year or for a specific province, let me know!
